title: Microbial carbon storage and nitrogen transformation in a pilot-scale anaerobic-oxic-anoxic wastewater treatment system
description: This project investigates microbial community composition and the genetic potential for carbon storage and nitrogen transformation in a pilot-scale anaerobic-oxic-anoxic (AOA) system treating municipal wastewater. Shotgun metagenomic sequencing was performed on independently collected AOA operating sludge (ZH_MG1, operating day 152) and AAO inoculum sludge (ZH_MG2, operating day 1). Three additional independent biological replicate sludge samples were collected at the same sampling time and location as each corresponding metagenomic sample for 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing. ZH_16S_1 to ZH_16S_3 represent AOA operating sludge, and ZH_16S_4 to ZH_16S_6 represent AAO inoculum sludge. All samples were collected from oxic tanks. Metagenome-assembled genomes were reconstructed to identify candidate hosts of glycogen metabolism and nitrogen transformation genes, with particular attention to a Promineifilum sp. population.
